BindNative.sig: void(void* fn, const char* name, const char* signature)

RCString::GetText.doc: The text of a JASS string argument: natives receive an RCString*. Returns [[this+8]+0x1C], or NULL without a string rep.

CreateJassString.doc: What natives returning a string return (I2S, SubString, GetPlayerName): adds the text to the map script's string table and returns its id, 0 for NULL. Reads CGameWar3.instance without checking it.

JassScanner::nextToken.doc: Memhack fix: reads the next token; returns its type code in eax (endfunction is 0x115; keywords get codes ~0x120-0x12d; identifiers tail-call the scanner's intern+classify, 0x9253E0). The token text is left in [this+0x98] (len [this+0xC4]). The memhack-guard patch hooks this (AFTER) to restore shadowed globals at the endfunction token. See docs/reverse-engineering.md, JASS compiler.

Jass::compile.sig: void*(void* context, void* callback, void* a0, int a1)
Jass::compile.doc: Memhack fix: the JASS compile driver. Builds the parser (0x9122E0) and the scanner (0x9246A0) on its own stack, runs the parse (0x913C30), then destroys the scanner (0x9245F0); both live in its stack frame. The only live caller of the scanner ctor (the other site, 0x9120E0, has no references), so every JassScanner::nextToken and JassLocalVarDesc::ctor runs inside one of these calls. ret 8. The memhack-guard patch hooks it (BEFORE and AFTER) to drop saved descriptors when a compile starts or ends, including one that stops inside a function. See docs/reverse-engineering.md, JASS compiler.

JassLocalVarDesc::ctor.sig: void(void* this, void* a0, void* typeNode, void* sym, void* a3)
JassLocalVarDesc::ctor.doc: Memhack fix: builds a local variable's type descriptor (desc+0x4=kind 0x29 local-var, desc+0x10=type-id from typeNode+0x10) and at 0x91DD5E writes sym+0x18=this descriptor, overwriting the symbol's current (possibly global) descriptor with no save and no endfunction restore. sym=3rd stack arg, typeNode=2nd. The memhack gateway. See docs/reverse-engineering.md, JASS compiler.

Native.CreateTrigger.doc: The common.j native: returns a trigger handle. Its first 48 bytes (a common SEH prologue) also occur elsewhere; Tome checks them at this address.

Native.Condition.doc: Returns the conditionfunc for a code value; the game keeps one per code (hash table at +0x1F4 of 0x1E0D70's object), so it isn't destroyed after use.

Native.TriggerAddCondition.bytes: 55 8b ec 8b 4d 08 56 e8 64 81 fd ff 8b f0 85 f6

Native.TriggerAddAction.bytes: 55 8b ec 8b 4d 08 e8 a5 81 fd ff 85 c0 75 02 5d

Native.TriggerExecute.bytes: 55 8b ec 8b 4d 08 e8 b5 80 fd ff 85 c0 74 09 6a
Native.TriggerExecute.doc: Runs the trigger's actions on new threads (0x2979A0); returns once they finish or wait.

Native.TriggerEvaluate.bytes: 55 8b ec 8b 4d 08 e8 d5 80 fd ff 85 c0 75 02 5d

LoadFrameDefToc.doc: Clears the frame definition tables, then calls LoadTocFiles.

LoadTocFiles.sig: int(const char* toc_path, void* table_a, void* table_b, void* status)
LoadTocFiles.doc: Parses every FDF a TOC lists into the tables, without clearing them.

FrameDefTableA.doc: First table LoadFrameDefToc passes to LoadTocFiles.

FrameDefTableB.doc: Second table LoadFrameDefToc passes to LoadTocFiles.

CreateFrame.sig: CFrame*(const char* template_name, CFrame* parent, int, int, int)

CFrame.layout.doc: The CLayoutFrame base inside every CFrame.

CFrame.vtable.Hide.doc: void __thiscall Hide(void). Sets bit 0 of the flags at +0xB0 and marks children hidden by parent.

CFrame.vtable.Show.doc: void __thiscall Show(void). Also shows every child.

CLayoutFrame::SetPoint.sig: void(CLayoutFrame* this, int point, CLayoutFrame* relative, int relative_point, float x, float y, int update)
CLayoutFrame::SetPoint.doc: Call on frame + CFrame.layout. Points follow 1.31's FRAMEPOINT numbering: TOPLEFT=0 ... CENTER=4 ... BOTTOMRIGHT=8.

SetAnimation.sig: void(CModelInstance* instance, const int* tags, int count, int flags)
SetAnimation.doc: Picks the sequence whose name matches the tags, e.g. {stand, options, alternate}.

CGlueMenu::BindControl.sig: CFrame*(CGlueMenu* this, const char* name, int command, int enable)
CGlueMenu::BindControl.doc: Looks the frame up and makes the menu receive its clicks as `command`. Crashes if the frame doesn't exist.

CMainMenu::OnEvent.doc: The command id is at event + 8.

CGlueMgr::Get.doc: The glue (menu) manager singleton, created on first use.

CGlueMgr::SetScreen.doc: Destroys the current glue screen and creates `screen` (a GlueScreen.* id) from the screen table at .data 0xCE50B8 ({FDF name, factory, id}). Afterwards CGlueMgr.screen is the new screen's frame.

CGlueMgr::EnterGame.doc: Loading finished: destroys the glue screen (CGlueMgr.screen_id becomes GlueScreen.none) and shows the game. CGameUI exists by now.

CGlueMgr.screen.doc: The current glue screen's frame (CMainMenu, CSinglePlayerMenu, ...), or null.

CGameWar3::Reset.doc: Tears down the previous game's state and re-registers the natives (InitNatives.call.map_load_1). Runs with leaving = 0 when a map starts loading (before its files are read) and with leaving = 1 when the player leaves a game.

Game.expansion.doc: int: 1 when the game runs as The Frozen Throne, 0 for Reign of Chaos. The function at 0x2DF4A0 returns the product code from it ('W3XP' for 1, 'WAR3'); 0x2DF470 (fastcall, ecx = this value) writes the game's name from the table at 0xAA9874.

CGameWar3.instance.doc: CGameWar3*: the current game, or null.

MapInfo.name.doc: RCString: the map's name, e.g. "Dustwallow Keys".

MapInfo.path.doc: RCString: the map's archive path, e.g. "Maps\(10)DustwallowKeys.w3m".

MapInfo.description.doc: RCString: the map's description from its war3map.w3i, trigger strings resolved.

CGameWar3.local_player.doc: uint16_t: the local player's slot. GetLocalPlayer reads +0x2A instead while the net client says so (0x32C110).

CGameWar3.player_count.doc: uint32_t: the length of the player array behind CGameWar3::GetPlayer (at +0x58); slots without a player are null.

CGameWar3.load_path.doc: RCString: the map or saved game a load request (0x1E7630: LoadGame, ChangeLevel, the in-game Load Game) asked for, e.g. "Save\Profile1\CustomSaves\<map>\<name>.w3z"; still there in the next game while it loads.

CGameWar3.load_is_save.doc: int: 1 if CGameWar3.load_path names a saved game (it ends in .w3z).

CGameWar3.handles.doc: The handle manager (what 0x1E0D70 returns, creating it if missing): JASS handle ids for agents. See HandleManager.*.

CGameWar3::GetPlayer.doc: The player in a slot ([game+0x58+slot*4], count at +0x54), or null. ret 4.

CPlayerWar3.name.doc: RCString: the player's name. CPlayerWar3::GetName (0x2684B0) with 1, as GetPlayerName uses it, writes "Player N" into it when it's empty; Tome only reads it.

CPlayerWar3.game_state.doc: int: 1 while the player is in the game, 2 once removed with a result (CPlayerWar3::RemovePlayer).

CSelectionWar3.local_leader.doc: CUnit*: the local player's active unit, whose portrait and commands show (Tab cycles it); set by 0x293110 ("Async set local leader"), read by 0x28FFE0.

CSelectionWar3.local_units.doc: The local selection, a unit group (UnitGroup.*); its count is at +0x10 (0x290270 reads +0x1F8). SelectUnit adds to it through 0x28DBE0 ("Add local"), at most 12.

UnitGroup.first.doc: The group's first node; a value <= 0 ends the list. Node: next at +4, CUnit* at +8 (0x290820).

UnitGroup.count.doc: uint32_t: the number of units in the group.

CAgent.id.doc: Two uint32_t: the agent's id. Lookups in the agent table take both (0x054530, then the record's tag '+agl' and +0x20 = 0 for a live one); the handle hash keys on the second.

CItem.type_id.doc: uint32_t: the item type, e.g. 'pinv' (GetItemTypeId); GetUnitTypeName names it too (GetItemName).

COrder.id.doc: uint32_t: the order id, e.g. 851986 (move); GetIssuedOrderId reads it from the unit's current order (0x685CD0).

COrder.x.doc: float: the order's target point, x (the point and target orders copy +0x48 and +0x50).

COrder.y.doc: float: the order's target point, y.

CUnit.vtable.doc: CUnit's vtable (RTTI), to tell a unit from other widgets.

CDestructable.type_id.doc: uint32_t: the destructable type, e.g. 'LTlt' (GetDestructableTypeId, 0x1FFA70); GetUnitTypeName names it too.

CAbility.type_id.doc: uint32_t: the ability's type, e.g. 'AHwe' (GetSpellAbilityId reads it through 0x684140).

CAbilitySpell.vtable.GetTargetWidget.doc: vtable slot: CWidget*(CAbility* this), thiscall: the spell's target widget or null (GetSpellTargetUnit, 0x202D00). Spell abilities only (CAbilitySpell and its subclasses, e.g. CAbilityItemHeal); every ability a spell event passes is one.

CAbilitySpell.vtable.GetTargetX.doc: vtable slot: float*(CAbility* this, float* out), thiscall, ret 4: the target point's x (GetSpellTargetX, 0x202E30). CAbilitySpell itself returns 0.

CAbilitySpell.vtable.GetTargetY.doc: vtable slot: like GetTargetX, for y (GetSpellTargetY, 0x202F10).

CUnit.owner.doc: int: the owner's player slot (the unit's vtable +0xEC returns it; GetOwningPlayer).

UnitFlag.not_hero.doc: CUnit.flags: never a hero. IsUnitType HERO (0x205540) is: the type id's first character is A-Z and this flag is clear.

GetUnitTypeName.doc: A unit type's localized name (the Name field; index picks one of several, clamped), or a placeholder for an unknown type. What GetUnitName (0x203D90) shows.

HandleManager.hash_buckets.doc: Buckets (12 bytes each: link offset at +0, first node at +8, <= 0 for none) of the agent-to-handle hash, keyed by the agent's id at +0x10. Node: key at +0, next at [node + link offset + 4], handle id at +0x18. 0x282E30 looks agents up there, and creates a handle if there's none.

HandleManager.hash_mask.doc: The hash's bucket mask; 0xFFFFFFFF while it's empty.

HandleManager.entries.doc: The handle table: 12 bytes per handle id from HandleId.first, the object at +4.

OnNetGameTick.bytes: 83 c1 14 e8 f8 15 ce ff b8 01 00 00 00 c3 cc cc
OnNetGameTick.doc: Handler of the network client's game tick (event 0x40090092, registered by 0x372920): advances the game's schedulers and timers (0x04C1A0) by the step at CNetEventGameTick.step. The client (0x32D670) dispatches it as game time accrues at the game speed, so it stops while the game is paused.

CNetEventGameTick.step.doc: float: the game time one tick advances, in seconds (0.005 in 1.27b, from .data 0xD69C48).

GameShutdown.bytes: e8 8b c7 ff ff e8 e6 c5 ff ff e8 f1 f2 14 00 6a
GameShutdown.doc: GameMain calls it once the main loop has ended (the player exited), before the game's systems are torn down. Main thread.

CGameUI::Get.doc: The in-game UI singleton (global 0xD6A8B8). create = 1 constructs it if there is none; forget = 1 clears the global.

CGameUI::HandleSlashCommand.doc: Called with every line sent from the in-game chat box. Handles the local commands (/mapname, /fps, /squelch, ...) and returns 1 for them; the line is then not sent and the chat box closes.

CGameUI::DisplayText.sig: void(CGameUI* this, float x, float y, const char* text, float duration, uint32_t color)
CGameUI::DisplayText.doc: Shows a message in the game's message area, like DisplayTimedTextToPlayer (which passes color 0xFFFFFFFF).

CPlayerWar3::OnUnitDeath.sig: void(CPlayerWar3* this, CUnit* unit, CUnit* killer)
CPlayerWar3::OnUnitDeath.doc: A unit of this player died; killer may be null. Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_DEATH (0x80214) for the player (registration checked inside, at 0x072190), so it runs whether or not a trigger listens. One caller, CUnit 0x67B8A0. ret 8.

CPlayerWar3::OnConstructFinish.doc: A building of this player was finished. Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_CONSTRUCT_FINISH (0x8021C) for the player (registration checked inside, at 0x072190), so it runs whether or not a trigger listens. One caller, CUnit 0x67B630. ret 4.

CPlayerWar3::OnTrainFinish.sig: void(CPlayerWar3* this, CUnit* building, CUnit* trained)
CPlayerWar3::OnTrainFinish.doc: A unit finished training: the building (GetTriggerUnit) and the new unit (GetTrainedUnit). Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_TRAIN_FINISH (0x80222) for the player (registration checked inside, at 0x072190), so it runs whether or not a trigger listens. One caller, CUnit 0x67D600. ret 8.

CPlayerWar3::OnUpgradeFinish.sig: void(CPlayerWar3* this, CUnit* unit, uint32_t value)
CPlayerWar3::OnUpgradeFinish.doc: A building finished upgrading (e.g. Town Hall to Keep; the unit has its new type). value goes to the event data's +0x44. Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_UPGRADE_FINISH (0x8021F) for the player (registration checked inside, at 0x072190), so it runs whether or not a trigger listens. One caller, CUnit 0x67D960. ret 8.

CPlayerWar3::OnResearchFinish.sig: void(CPlayerWar3* this, CUnit* unit, uint32_t research)
CPlayerWar3::OnResearchFinish.doc: A research finished: the unit that researched it and the research id (GetResearched, event data +0x44). Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_RESEARCH_FINISH (0x80225) for the player (registration checked inside, at 0x072190), so it runs whether or not a trigger listens. One caller, CUnit 0x67C690. ret 8.

CPlayerWar3::OnHeroLevel.doc: A hero gained a level. Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_HERO_LEVEL (0x80229) for the player (registration checked inside, at 0x072190), so it runs whether or not a trigger listens. One caller, CUnit 0x67A230. ret 4.

CPlayerWar3::OnSummon.sig: void(CPlayerWar3* this, CUnit* summoner, CUnit* summoned)
CPlayerWar3::OnSummon.doc: A unit was summoned: the summoner (GetSummoningUnit) and the summoned unit (GetTriggerUnit, GetSummonedUnit). Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SUMMON (0x8022F) for the player (registration checked inside, at 0x072190), so it runs whether or not a trigger listens. One caller, CUnit 0x67B0B0. ret 8.

CPlayerWar3::OnPickupItem.sig: void(CPlayerWar3* this, CUnit* unit, CItem* item)
CPlayerWar3::OnPickupItem.doc: A unit picked up (or was given) an item. Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_PICKUP_ITEM (0x80231) for the player (registration checked inside, at 0x072190), so it runs whether or not a trigger listens. One caller, CUnit 0x67ACF0. ret 8.

CPlayerWar3::OnDropItem.sig: void(CPlayerWar3* this, CUnit* unit, CItem* item)
CPlayerWar3::OnDropItem.doc: A unit dropped (or lost) an item. Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_DROP_ITEM (0x80230) for the player (registration checked inside, at 0x072190), so it runs whether or not a trigger listens. One caller, CUnit 0x679FE0. ret 8.

CPlayerWar3::OnUseItem.sig: void(CPlayerWar3* this, CUnit* unit, CItem* item)
CPlayerWar3::OnUseItem.doc: A unit used an item. Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_USE_ITEM (0x80232) for the player (registration checked inside, at 0x072190), so it runs whether or not a trigger listens. One caller, CUnit 0x67DBA0. ret 8.

CPlayerWar3::OnVictory.doc: The player won: fires EVENT_PLAYER_VICTORY (0x8020E), registration checked inside. Callers: the result setter 0x269BB0 (switch: 0 victory, 1 defeat) and the game UI (0x37A77C).

CPlayerWar3::OnDefeat.doc: The player lost: fires EVENT_PLAYER_DEFEAT (0x8020D). Callers: 0x269BB0 and the game UI (0x379FAC).

CPlayerWar3::OnLeave.doc: The player left the game: fires EVENT_PLAYER_LEAVE (0x8020F). Four callers in the network code (0x2A0F66, 0x2A0F8F, 0x2A27FC, 0x2A2953).

HandleManager::FireGameSave.doc: Fires EVENT_GAME_SAVE (0x80303) with the save's name. Called by the network save handler (0x26F4F6) after it pauses the game (SetPaused(1, 0xFF, 1, 0, 0)) and before the game is written. ret 4.

HandleManager::FireGameLoaded.doc: Fires EVENT_GAME_LOADED (0x80300). Called by the saved game loader (0x1E3730, at 0x1E3C0F) once the saved state is read, before CGlueMgr::EnterGame.

CUnit::GetHeroLevel.doc: A hero's level (GetHeroLevel calls it for heroes only).

CGameWar3::SaveGame.doc: Writes the saved game (a CSaveGame, 0x1D8DD0) to path, e.g. "Save\Profile1\CustomSaves\<map>\<name>". Both ways to save call it: the SaveGame native (0x2113F0, path from 0x1FFFD0) and the network save handler for the Esc menu's Save Game (0x26F51F, path from 0x2BFC90, after HandleManager::FireGameSave). Returns early in replays (0x32C110).

CPlayerWar3::RemovePlayer.doc: What RemovePlayer (0x210A40) does: result is a playergameresult (0 victory, 1 defeat, 2 tie, 3 neutral). Only while CPlayerWar3.game_state is 1: stores the result, sets the state to 2, and reports it to the net client (0x32CF60: victory 4, defeat 3, tie 5), or, while +0x268 is set, calls OnVictory or OnDefeat instead. Melee's victory and defeat (MeleeDoVictoryEnum, MeleeDoDefeat) end here. ret 4.

CPlayerWar3::OnUnitAttacked.sig: void(CPlayerWar3* this, CUnit* attacker, CUnit* attacked)
CPlayerWar3::OnUnitAttacked.doc: A unit of this player is being attacked (GetTriggerUnit: attacked, GetAttacker). Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_ATTACKED (0x80212) for the player, registration checked inside (0x072190); called unconditionally by CUnit 0x67B2E0. ret 8.

CPlayerWar3::OnUnitRescued.sig: void(CPlayerWar3* this, CUnit* rescuer, CUnit* rescued)
CPlayerWar3::OnUnitRescued.doc: A unit was rescued (GetRescuer). Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_RESCUED (0x80213) for the player, registration checked inside (0x072190); called unconditionally by CUnit 0x67C450. ret 8.

CPlayerWar3::OnConstructStart.doc: Construction of a building began (GetConstructingStructure). Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_CONSTRUCT_START (0x8021A) for the player, registration checked inside (0x072190); called unconditionally by three build paths (0x54A5B0, 0x54D0F0, 0x54D9D0). ret 4.

CPlayerWar3::OnConstructCancel.doc: A building under construction was cancelled (GetCancelledStructure). Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_CONSTRUCT_CANCEL (0x8021B) for the player, registration checked inside (0x072190); called unconditionally by CUnit 0x67B520. ret 4.

CPlayerWar3::OnUpgradeStart.sig: void(CPlayerWar3* this, CUnit* unit, uint32_t type)
CPlayerWar3::OnUpgradeStart.doc: A building began upgrading to type (event data +0x44). Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_UPGRADE_START (0x8021D) for the player, registration checked inside (0x072190); called unconditionally by CUnit 0x67DA80. ret 8.

CPlayerWar3::OnUpgradeCancel.sig: void(CPlayerWar3* this, CUnit* unit, uint32_t type)
CPlayerWar3::OnUpgradeCancel.doc: An upgrade was cancelled. Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_UPGRADE_CANCEL (0x8021E) for the player, registration checked inside (0x072190); called unconditionally by CUnit 0x67D840. ret 8.

CPlayerWar3::OnTrainStart.sig: void(CPlayerWar3* this, CUnit* building, uint32_t type)
CPlayerWar3::OnTrainStart.doc: A building began training a unit type (GetTrainedUnitType, event data +0x44). Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_TRAIN_START (0x80220) for the player, registration checked inside (0x072190); called unconditionally by CUnit 0x67D720. ret 8.

CPlayerWar3::OnTrainCancel.sig: void(CPlayerWar3* this, CUnit* building, uint32_t type)
CPlayerWar3::OnTrainCancel.doc: Training was cancelled. Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_TRAIN_CANCEL (0x80221) for the player, registration checked inside (0x072190); called unconditionally by CUnit 0x67D4E0. ret 8.

CPlayerWar3::OnResearchStart.sig: void(CPlayerWar3* this, CUnit* unit, uint32_t research)
CPlayerWar3::OnResearchStart.doc: A research began (GetResearched). Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_RESEARCH_START (0x80223) for the player, registration checked inside (0x072190); called unconditionally by CUnit 0x67C7B0. ret 8.

CPlayerWar3::OnResearchCancel.sig: void(CPlayerWar3* this, CUnit* unit, uint32_t research)
CPlayerWar3::OnResearchCancel.doc: A research was cancelled. Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_RESEARCH_CANCEL (0x80224) for the player, registration checked inside (0x072190); called unconditionally by CUnit 0x67C570. ret 8.

CPlayerWar3::OnHeroSkill.sig: void(CPlayerWar3* this, CUnit* hero, uint32_t ability, int level)
CPlayerWar3::OnHeroSkill.doc: A hero learned a skill (GetLearnedSkill +0x44, GetLearnedSkillLevel +0x48). Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_HERO_SKILL (0x8022A) for the player, registration checked inside (0x072190); called unconditionally by CUnit 0x67A770. ret 0xC.

CPlayerWar3::OnHeroRevivable.doc: A dead hero became revivable. Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_HERO_REVIVABLE (0x8022B) for the player, registration checked inside (0x072190); called unconditionally by 0x26AD96. ret 4.

CPlayerWar3::OnHeroReviveStart.doc: A hero's revival began at an altar (GetRevivingUnit). Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_HERO_REVIVE_START (0x8022C) for the player, registration checked inside (0x072190); called unconditionally by CUnit 0x67A660. ret 4.

CPlayerWar3::OnHeroReviveCancel.doc: A hero's revival was cancelled. Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_HERO_REVIVE_CANCEL (0x8022D) for the player, registration checked inside (0x072190); called unconditionally by CUnit 0x67A440. ret 4.

CPlayerWar3::OnHeroReviveFinish.doc: A hero was revived. Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_HERO_REVIVE_FINISH (0x8022E) for the player, registration checked inside (0x072190); called unconditionally by CUnit 0x67A550. ret 4.

CPlayerWar3::OnUnitSell.sig: void(CPlayerWar3* this, CUnit* shop, CUnit* sold, CUnit* buyer)
CPlayerWar3::OnUnitSell.doc: A shop sold a unit (GetSellingUnit +0x30, GetSoldUnit +0x3C, GetBuyingUnit +0x48). Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SELL (0x8030D) for the player, registration checked inside (0x072190); called unconditionally by CUnit 0x67C8D0. ret 0xC.

CPlayerWar3::OnItemSell.sig: void(CPlayerWar3* this, CUnit* shop, CUnit* buyer, CItem* item)
CPlayerWar3::OnItemSell.doc: A shop sold an item (GetSellingUnit, GetBuyingUnit, GetSoldItem). Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SELL_ITEM (0x8030F) for the player, registration checked inside (0x072190); called unconditionally by CUnit 0x67CA00. ret 0xC.

CPlayerWar3::OnItemPawn.sig: void(CPlayerWar3* this, CUnit* seller, CUnit* shop, CItem* item)
CPlayerWar3::OnItemPawn.doc: A unit sold (pawned) an item to a shop. Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_PAWN_ITEM (0x80315) for the player, registration checked inside (0x072190); called unconditionally by CUnit 0x67C100. ret 0xC.

CPlayerWar3::OnUnitChangeOwner.sig: void(CPlayerWar3* this, CUnit* unit, int previous_owner)
CPlayerWar3::OnUnitChangeOwner.doc: A unit changed owner (GetChangingUnitPrevOwner, the low 16 bits at event data +0x44). Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_CHANGE_OWNER (0x8030E) for the player, registration checked inside (0x072190); called unconditionally by CUnit 0x67B400. ret 8.

CUnit::OnOrder.doc: A unit was given an order with no target (stop, hold, train...). Fires EVENT_UNIT_ISSUED_ORDER (0x8024B) and the owner's EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_ISSUED_ORDER (0x80226, CPlayerWar3 0x2610C0), but returns early unless a trigger listens for one of them. The order dispatchers 0x67ABE0 and 0x688790 pick it, OnPointOrder or OnTargetOrder by the order's class. ret 4.

CUnit::OnPointOrder.doc: A unit was given an order with a target point (move, attack-move, build): EVENT_UNIT_ISSUED_POINT_ORDER and the player's (0x80227, 0x2614E0), with the same early return. ret 4.

CUnit::OnTargetOrder.doc: A unit was given an order with a target widget (attack, smart on a unit, pick up an item): EVENT_UNIT_ISSUED_TARGET_ORDER and the player's (0x80228, 0x262360), same early return. Callers: both dispatchers and 0x423EA9. ret 4.

CUnit::OnLoaded.doc: A unit was loaded into a transport (GetLoadedUnit: this, GetTransportUnit): EVENT_UNIT_LOADED (0x80258) and the owner's EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_LOADED (0x80233, CPlayerWar3 0x2611D0), but only if a trigger listens for one of them. One caller, 0x59FCE4. ret 4.

CUnit::OnSpellChannel.doc: A unit began channeling a spell: EVENT_UNIT_SPELL_CHANNEL (0x80322) and the owner's EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_CHANNEL (0x80310, CPlayerWar3 0x261E20). Checks both registrations itself and returns early unless a trigger listens (it makes a handle for the event data), so Tome hooks this instead of the player function. The ability goes to the event data through 0x697E50 (GetSpellAbility). One caller, 0x3FBB80. ret 4.

CUnit::OnSpellCast.doc: A unit began casting a spell (EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_CAST 0x80311, CPlayerWar3 0x261D10; the unit event 0x80321), like CUnit::OnSpellChannel. One caller, 0x3FB5D0. ret 4.

CUnit::OnSpellEffect.doc: A spell took effect (EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_EFFECT 0x80312, CPlayerWar3 0x261F30; the unit event 0x80323), like CUnit::OnSpellChannel. Callers 0x3F8C30, 0x40B380, 0x5617F0. ret 4.

CUnit::OnSpellFinish.doc: A spell finished (EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_FINISH 0x80313, CPlayerWar3 0x262150; the unit event 0x80325), like CUnit::OnSpellChannel. One caller, 0x40E030. ret 4.

CUnit::OnSpellEndCast.doc: A unit stopped casting, finished or not (EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_SPELL_ENDCAST 0x80314, CPlayerWar3 0x262040; the unit event 0x80324), like CUnit::OnSpellChannel. One caller, 0x40C3F0. ret 4.

CUnit::OnDamaged.sig: void(CUnit* this, float* damage, CUnit* source)
CUnit::OnDamaged.doc: A unit takes damage, before its life goes down: EVENT_UNIT_DAMAGED (0x80234, a unit event only; GetEventDamage reads the amount from event data +0x30, GetEventDamageSource the source). Checks the registration itself; called unconditionally by 0x69CA80 (ecx = unit, edx = &source, stack: float* damage, flag), which then applies the damage. source may be null. ret 8.

CUnit::OnAcquireTarget.doc: A unit acquired a target: EVENT_UNIT_ACQUIRED_TARGET (0x8023C, a unit event only; GetEventTargetUnit). Checks the registration itself; called unconditionally by the attack AI (0x4935E0, 0x493FF0, 0x49E130). ret 4.

CPlayerWar3::OnUnitDecay.doc: A dead unit of this player began to decay (GetDecayingUnit). Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_DECAY (0x80215), registration checked inside (0x072190); called unconditionally by CUnit 0x67B9C0, which then fires the unit event (0x80236). ret 4.

CPlayerWar3::OnUnitDetected.doc: This player detected an invisible unit (GetDetectedUnit, GetEventDetectingPlayer: this). Fires the JASS EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_DETECTED (0x80216) for the detecting player, registration checked inside; called by CUnit 0x67BAD0 (this = the unit, the player as its argument) whenever it has a player. ret 4.

CPlayerWar3::OnUnitHidden.doc: EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_HIDDEN (0x80217) for this player, registration checked inside; called by CUnit 0x67BBF0 like OnUnitDetected. ret 4.

CPlayerWar3::OnEndCinematic.doc: The player pressed Esc (cinematic mode or not): EVENT_PLAYER_END_CINEMATIC (0x80211), registration checked inside. Called by the network action handler 0x26F240 with the action's player (+0x15). ret.

CPlayerWar3::OnArrowKey.doc: The player pressed or released an arrow key: event is the JASS event id + 0x80200, EVENT_PLAYER_ARROW_LEFT_DOWN (0x80305) to EVENT_PLAYER_ARROW_UP_UP (0x8030C): left, right, down, up, each down then up. Registration checked inside. Called by the network action handler 0x26EE00. ret 4.

CWidget::OnDeath.doc: A widget (unit, item or destructable) died: posts EVENT_WIDGET_DEATH (0x80259) to the local player (0x262DF0) and to the widget itself. Callers: CDestructable 0x657770 (KillDestructable, damage), CItem 0x6C0870, CUnit 0x679AC0 and others. ret.

CScriptDialog::OnClick.sig: void(CScriptDialog* this, CScriptDialogButton* button, int player)
CScriptDialog::OnClick.doc: A player clicked a dialog button (GetClickedDialog, GetClickedButton, GetTriggerPlayer): posts EVENT_DIALOG_CLICK (0x8025B) to the dialog and EVENT_DIALOG_BUTTON_CLICK to the button. Called by the network action handler 0x26EFF0 (player from the action's +0x15) and 0x22E460. ret 8.

OnNetShowSkillMenu.doc: Handler of action 0x66 (registered by 0x271400): a player opened a hero's skill menu. Fires EVENT_GAME_SHOW_SKILL (0x80209, HandleManager 0x284B90, registration checked there). The sender (0x2705D0) is called by the command card (0x392C90, 0x393AF0, 0x3BCB90) on every click of the button, whether or not a trigger listens. The event's player is CNetEvent.sender. Plain ret.

OnNetShowBuildMenu.doc: Handler of action 0x67: a player opened a worker's build menu. Fires EVENT_GAME_BUILD_SUBMENU (0x8020A, 0x284BA0). Sent like OnNetShowSkillMenu (0x270640). Plain ret.

CNetEvent.sender.doc: uint8_t: the player slot that sent a network action, as received (every action; see CNetEventSyncStoredInteger.sender).

HandleManager::FireEndLevel.doc: Fires EVENT_GAME_END_LEVEL (0x80201). Called once, at the end of 0x1E7630, which the ChangeLevel (0x1F89E0) and LoadGame (0x20E070) natives and the restart path (0x1E7370: RestartGame, the menus' Restart) go through before the current game is torn down. Plain ret.

CreateUnitObject.sig: CUnit*(int player, uint32_t type_id, const float* x, const float* y, const float* facing, uint32_t flags, int a, int b)
CreateUnitObject.doc: Creates a unit and places it: every unit the game makes goes through it (31 callers: the CreateUnit natives through 0x64E650 with flags 0x502, training 0x600E60, summons, preplaced units). Returns the CUnit, or null. ret 0x18.

CUnit::Remove.sig: void(CUnit* this, int a, int b)
CUnit::Remove.doc: Takes a unit out of the game: RemoveUnit (0x210C10) calls it with (1, 1), as do ReplaceUnit-style paths (0x1FB4F0) and a few abilities (0x543E50, 0x5CD500, 0x5D6BF0, 0x641530). Sends the unit message 0xD0164 to itself (no other function sends it) and clears its orders (0x67DF00). A corpse that finishes decaying doesn't come here. ret 8.

CAbilityHero::AddXP.sig: void(CAbilityHero* this, const float* xp, int a, int b, int c, int d, int e)
CAbilityHero::AddXP.doc: Gives a hero experience: the hero ability (CUnit +0x1F0; its unit at CAbility.owner) adds *xp to CAbilityHero.xp and levels the hero up. Every way in comes here: kills (0x527B90), AddHeroXP/SetHeroXP/SetHeroLevel (through CUnit 0x680630) and 0x52AE10. Nothing is added at the maximum level. ret 0x18.

CAbility.owner.doc: CUnit*: the unit that has the ability (0x528110 reads it; 0x055CC0 looks it up when it's null).

CPlayerWar3.states.doc: The player's states (GetPlayerState 0x201AD0, SetPlayerState 0x213FB0 through 0x1E98E0): one PlayerState.size record per JASS playerstate, read with SyncedInt::Get. Gold and lumber (states 1 and 2, and 15 and 16, gathered) are stored times 10.

SyncedInt::Get.bytes: 8b 51 0c 8b 49 08 e8 e5 da ff ff 8b 40 78 c3 cc
SyncedInt::Get.doc: The integer a synced value holds: looks up its agent (ids at +8, 0x054530) and reads +0x78. Player states and other synced game values use it. Plain ret.

GetFloatGameState.doc: The JASS native: state 2 (GAME_STATE_TIME_OF_DAY) is the time of day in hours (0-24); others return 0. The real comes back as its bits in eax, like every native. Needs a game. Plain ret.

COrder::GetTarget.doc: The order's target widget (unit, item or destructable) from the agent id at +0x58, or null.

CGameUI::DisplayChatMessage.sig: void(CGameUI* this, int player, const char* text, int recipient, float duration)
CGameUI::DisplayChatMessage.doc: Shows a player's chat message in the message area, with the recipient prefix (CHAT_RECIPIENT_*: 0 all, 1 allies, 2 observers or referees, else private) and the player's colored name. Returns at once without a message frame (+0x3EC). ret 0x10, two callers in CGameUI's chat handling.

CGameUI::SetPaused.sig: void(CGameUI* this, int pause, int player, int a3, int a4, int a5)
CGameUI::SetPaused.doc: Pauses or resumes the game for a player (0xFF: none): PauseGame (0x20F4F0) passes (pause, local player, 0, 1, 1); the network pause and resume handlers 0x370900 and 0x370CB0 (pause, the event's player at +0x15, 1, 0, 0). Asks the net client (0x32AFF0 pause, 0x32B080 resume) and shows PAUSE_GAME_NOTIFY / RESUME_GAME_NOTIFY. ret 0x14.

PresentFrame.doc: Presents a rendered frame (graphics device vtable +0x48, D3D or OpenGL). Called once per frame on the main thread, in menus, loading screens and games.

CObserver.vtable.OnEvent.doc: int __thiscall(CEvent*), ret 4. For a control's click, the command id is at event + 8.

CFrame::SetFocus.sig: void(CFrame* this, int focus, int, CFrame* other)
CFrame::SetFocus.doc: focus = 1 gives the frame the keyboard focus (vtable +0xAC decides), focus = 0 takes it from whichever frame has it (vtable +0xB0 on that one). The focused frame is FocusedFrame.

FocusedFrame.doc: CFrame*: the frame with the keyboard focus, or null.

CControl::SetListener.sig: void(CControl* this, int command, CObserver* listener, int enable)
CControl::SetListener.doc: Makes clicks on the control reach listener->OnEvent with `command` (event 0x40090064). The registration holds a reference to the listener (refcount at +4).

CControl::Click.doc: Clicks the control as the player would: if it's enabled (0x072190 with 0x40090064), fills the event at 0xCE3BA8 (button at +0x10, the control at +0x14) and dispatches it through its vtable +0x10, which notifies its listeners. ret 4. Mouse paths pass the mouse event's button; a shortcut path (0x0FEA8F) passes 1.

CLayoutFrame::SetWidth.doc: Stores the width at +0x58, then updates the layout (tail call to 0x111390, ret 4). Call on frame + CFrame.layout. SetHeight is 0x111520 (+0x5C).

CEscMenuMainPanel::Setup.doc: vtable slot 55 (CEscMenuMainPanel vtable 0xABDAEC). Finds MainPanel, EndGamePanel, ConfirmQuitPanel, HelpPanel and TipsPanel, stores their sizes, and binds the buttons (commands 0-0x12: Pause 0, Save 1, Load 2, Options 3, Help 4, Tips 5, End Game 7, Return 8, ...). ret 8.

CEscMenuMainPanel::SetPanel.doc: Switches the Esc menu's main panel (EscMenuPanel.*: 0 none, 1 main, 2 and 6 End Game, 3 and 7 Confirm Quit, 4 Help, 5 Tips): hides all five panels, resizes the backdrop to the new one's size and shows it; the current one is at +0x168. ret 4.

EscMenuPanel.main.doc: CEscMenuMainPanel::SetPanel: the main panel (MainPanel), as the menu opens and as Help's OK goes back. 0 shows no panel.

CEditBox::GetText.bytes: 8b 81 e4 01 00 00 c3 cc cc cc cc cc cc cc cc cc 55
CEditBox::GetText.doc: The edit box's text buffer (+0x1E4), UTF-8. 57 callers (CChatEditBar reads its edit box through it).

CEditBox::SetText.sig: void(CEditBox* this, const char* text, int notify)
CEditBox::SetText.doc: Replaces the text (cut to the box's maximum length, +0x1F0), puts the cursor at the end and redraws; notify = 1 also sends the change event 0x400B0065 (0x102A40). ret 8, 72 callers.

CGameUI::SetMode.sig: void(CGameUI* this, void* mode, int push)
CGameUI::SetMode.doc: Switches the in-game UI's mode (the current one at +0x1B4; push = 1 keeps the old one on the stack at +0x1B8 for 0x3745F0 to go back to). The Esc menu opens with SetMode(CGameUI.esc_menu, 1) after CEscMenu::Reset. ret 8.

CGameUI.paused_by_player.doc: int: set by CGameUI::SetPaused from a player's pause or resume (a3 = 1): 1 while a player has the game paused.

CGameUI.paused_by_trigger.doc: int: set by CGameUI::SetPaused when a5 = 1 (PauseGame): 1 while a trigger has the game paused; a player's resume can't end that.

CGameUI.mode.doc: The current mode object (CEscMenu while the Esc menu is open).

CGameUI.esc_menu.doc: The CEscMenu (vtable 0xABDF34), made once per game.

CEscMenu::Reset.doc: What F10 and the Menu button do before opening the menu: the options panel to its first state (0x3CF230(0)) and the main panel to EscMenuPanel.main.

EscMenuPanel.help.doc: CEscMenuMainPanel::SetPanel: the Help panel (HelpPanel, 0.432 x 0.384). Tome's in-game mod menu takes its place.

GlueScreen.game_chatroom.doc: The game lobby (CGameChatroom): LAN and Battle.net games before they start.

CGameChatroom::OnChatReceived.doc: A lobby chat line arrived (lobby event 0x10, delivered to the chatroom's OnEvent 0x2EF2D0 as code 9; registered by 0x2FF2AC): prefixes the sender's name (NetGetPlayerName) and adds the line to the chat area with CTextArea::AddText. The sender doesn't get its own line back; the send handler (0x2F9B50) adds it locally. ret 4.

CGameChatroom::StartGame.doc: The lobby's Start Game button (command 0 of the chatroom's OnEvent): host only (NetIsHost), checks the slots (0x29FEA0; a dialog through 0x2BC510 if the teams don't allow a start), then starts the countdown (0x32AD30). Plain ret.

CGameChatroom.net_index.doc: int: the local client's index in the net client, passed to every net call the lobby makes (NetIsHost, NetGetLocalPlayer, NetGetPlayerName, NetSendLobbyEvent).

CTextArea::AddText.doc: Appends a line to a text area (the lobby chat, the Battle.net chat). Color codes work. ret 4.

CNetEventLobby::Init.doc: Constructs a lobby event in place: vtable 0xAAA270, id 0xB0000 | type at +8, the type byte at +0x14, the sender at +0x15 (0 until it's received), an empty text at +0x18. Type 0x10 is chat (LobbyEvent.chat). ret 4.

CNetEventLobby.sender.doc: uint8_t: the net player id of the sender, as the receiver sees it.

CNetEventLobby.text.doc: char[0x100]: a chat line (the send handler copies at most 0xFF bytes).

CNetEventLobby.size.doc: Bytes from the start of a chat event to the end of its text.

LobbyEvent.chat.doc: The lobby event type of chat lines (CNetEventLobby::Init).

NetSendLobbyEvent.sig: void(int recipient, CNetEventLobby* event, int net_index)
NetSendLobbyEvent.doc: Sends a lobby event to one net player id (0xFD: every player; the lobby chat uses that). Wraps 0x2C2630 (a list of ids) and the net client's 0x32CA60, which serializes the event and sends it through the host. ret 4.

NetGetPlayerName.doc: The name of a net player id, NULL for an id with no player. Looks the id up with 0x3299A0 in the net client's player lists (ids below 0x80 in one, the others in a second). Plain ret.

NetGetLocalPlayer.doc: The local player's net id (a byte in al; 0xFF without a net client): the byte at +0x2DC of the client's block (net client + index * 0x304). Plain ret.

NetIsHost.doc: Whether this client hosts the game: 1 for game type 'NONE', 0 once the client's state (+0x278 of its block) is 3 or more (the game started), otherwise the flag at +0x28C of its block. The Start button checks it. Plain ret.

NetIsReplay.doc: 1 while a replay plays (the net client's +0x610 is 1). The SyncStored* natives send nothing then. Plain ret.

CNetEventSyncStoredInteger::Init.doc: Constructs action 0x6B (SyncStoredInteger) in place: vtable 0xAA131C, id 0xA006B at +8, 0x6B at +0x14, empty names, a zeroed value object at +0x318. The native's builder (0x270C20) copies the cache's file name, the mission key and the key (at most 0x100 bytes each), sets the value and sends it with NetSendAction. Plain ret.

CNetEventSyncStoredInteger.sender.doc: uint8_t: the player slot that sent the action, as received.

CNetEventSyncStoredInteger.file.doc: char[0x100]: the game cache's file name.

CNetEventSyncStoredInteger.value_object.doc: The value object the receiver stores (0x24A420); its integer is at +0x18 (CNetEventSyncStoredInteger.value).

SyncValue::Destroy.doc: Frees what a sync action's value object (CNetEventSyncStoredInteger.value_object) holds; the native's builder calls it after sending. Plain ret.

NetSendAction.doc: Sends a player action: writes the action byte (+0x14) and the action's data into a data store and hands it to the net client (0x32C920), which schedules it for every player and the replay. The SyncStored* builders pass flags = 0. Plain ret.

OnNetSyncStoredInteger.doc: Handler of action 0x6B on every client and in replays (registered with 0x32C4D0 by 0x271400, the table of action handlers 0x50-0x75): stores the value in the named game cache through 0x24A420, which creates the cache if none has that name. Plain ret.

CPlayerWar3.controller.doc: int: the mapcontrol (0 user, 1 computer, ...), as GetPlayerController (0x201710) reads it.

CPlayerWar3.race.doc: int: the player's race as GetPlayerRace (0x2017C0) reads it: 1 human, 2 orc, 3 undead, 4 night elf. 1 is also what the native returns for a player that doesn't exist.

Import.GetTickCount.doc: game.dll's clock for nearly everything: the main loop's scheduler (0x07B1C0) runs its tasks, the frame among them, by it, and frames take their time from it (0x092620). Mostly called through the thunk 0x092A10 (jmp [slot]). Windows advances it in 15.6 ms steps, which holds the frame rate near 64 whatever maxfps says.

Options::Get.doc: The game's options (the registry's Video, Gameplay, Sound ... values), created on first use and kept at .data 0xD3C5F0. Plain ret.

Options::Apply.doc: Applies the stored value of one option (an Option.* id) to the running game, through the switch at 0x0403E0. Doesn't save it. ret 4.

Option.maxfps.doc: Video\maxfps (default 200). Applying it sets the main loop's period to (int)(1000.0 / maxfps) ms with Scheduler::SetPeriod.

Scheduler::SetPeriod.doc: Sets how often a thread's scheduler loop (0x07B1C0) runs its frame: the main thread's draws a frame at most every period_ms milliseconds of GetTickCount. context 0 means the calling thread's. Stores the period at +0x48 of the loop's record. Plain ret.

CGxDeviceD3d::BuildPresentParams.doc: Fills the D3DPRESENT_PARAMETERS for CreateDevice (call at 0x13FC2E) and for Reset after a lost device (0x1404DD). PresentationInterval (+0x34) is always 0, D3DPRESENT_INTERVAL_DEFAULT: vsync on. ret 4.

CGxDeviceD3d::CanDraw.doc: Device vtable +0x3C, called before every frame (0x1365C0). TestCooperativeLevel; on D3DERR_DEVICENOTRESET (or a pending resize, +0x730) releases resources (0x13FDC0), BuildPresentParams, IDirect3DDevice9::Reset, then RestoreState. False while the device is lost or the window has no area. Plain ret.

CGxDeviceD3d::RestoreState.doc: Sets the device's render states, lights and so on again: called after CreateDevice (0x13FC9A) and after a successful Reset (0x1404FA). Ends with SetGamma(gamma, force 1), so the ramp is sent again after every Reset. Plain ret.

CGxDeviceD3d::SetGamma.sig: void(CGxDeviceD3d* this, float exponent, int force)
CGxDeviceD3d::SetGamma.doc: Device vtable +0x1C. Returns at once if exponent is within 2.4e-7 of the cached one (CGxDevice.gamma) and force is 0; else caches it and, in fullscreen (+0x9C) with D3DCAPS2_FULLSCREENGAMMA (0x20000 in +0x594), sends IDirect3DDevice9::SetGammaRamp(0, 0, ramp) with ramp[i] = (i/255)^(exponent + rand()/32767/1000) * 65535. ret 8.

CGxDeviceD3d::WndProc.sig: intptr_t(void* hwnd, uint32_t msg, uintptr_t wparam, intptr_t lparam)
CGxDeviceD3d::WndProc.doc: The Direct3D window's procedure (device from GWL_USERDATA). Tracks WM_SETFOCUS/WM_KILLFOCUS in .data 0xD54400; on WM_SYSKEYUP with VK_TAB while focused (Alt+Tab away) it calls SetGamma(1.0, 1) to give the desktop a neutral ramp, writes the user's exponent back into CGxDevice.gamma without applying it, and calls the callback at +0x570 with 1. RestoreState applies it again after the device Reset that follows. ret 0x10.

CGxDevice.gamma.doc: float: the gamma ramp exponent last passed to SetGamma (1.0 from the constructor). The Gamma option g (0-100) gives (100 - g) / 100 + 0.2.

CGxDevice.fullscreen.doc: int: nonzero in fullscreen, 0 in a window (both renderers). 0x138990 returns it negated; the gamma setters (D3D 0x13F870, OpenGL 0x13AD60) send a ramp only when it's set. gl-context-restore reads it.

CGxDeviceD3d.window.doc: HWND: the device's window (CanDraw's GetClientRect, DestroyWindow in 0x1401E0).

CGxDeviceD3d.d3d_device.doc: IDirect3DDevice9*: the device (0 before CreateDevice and after teardown).

CGxDeviceD3d::ReleaseForReset.doc: Clears the device's state caches (render states +0x748, 256 x 12 bytes; texture stages +0x1348/+0x1358; lights +0x1B58, 8 x 0x74) and releases the 7 surfaces at +0x6C0..+0x6D8; with release_textures != 0 also the textures (0x143B00). Called with 0 before IDirect3DDevice9::Reset (0x1404D2) and with 1 by the teardown (0x13FD2B). The d3d-reset-lights patch hooks it (BEFORE). ret 4.

C44Matrix::Perspective.sig: void(float* this, float fov, float aspect, float near, float far)
C44Matrix::Perspective.doc: Fills the 4x4 matrix at this with a perspective projection: t = tan(fov * 0.5 / sqrt(aspect^2 + 1)), m[0] = 1/(t*aspect), m[5] = 1/t, m[10] = (far+near)/(far-near), m[11] = 1, m[14] = -2*far*near/(far-near). Only caller: the camera's projection setup 0x1ADF40 (fov from camera +0x114, aspect from its viewport rect, which is in the 0.8 x 0.6 UI space, so a 4:3 picture whatever the window). The widescreen patch hooks it (AFTER). ret 0x10.

CCamera::SetupProjection.sig: void(void* this, const float* rect, int unused)
CCamera::SetupProjection.doc: Builds a camera's projection for its viewport: calls C44Matrix::Perspective (0x126E30, its only caller) with fov from this +0x114, near +0xCC, far +0xAC and aspect from rect (in the 0.8 x 0.6 UI space, so 4/3 for the world view in any window). Its one caller is the wrapper at 0x1ADE90 (ecx, edx = rect, one stack argument; ret 4), which pushes both arguments; the second isn't read. ret 8.

WorldView::SetupCamera.sig: void(void* this, float delta, const float* rect)
WorldView::SetupCamera.doc: Sets up the world camera for a frame (name guessed): if this +0x38 is 1 it first calls 0x1A2C10 on +0x5C with delta, then the camera wrapper 0x1ADE90 (ecx = this +0x34, edx = rect, which runs CCamera::SetupProjection). Called once per frame in a game only, from 0x385D55 (the world frame's update, this = its +0x19C). The other cameras that reach Perspective don't pass here: 3D models in UI frames (0x0F64E0, in menus and games) and the main menu's 3D background (0x78D0E0). The widescreen patch hooks it (BEFORE and AFTER) to scale only the world view. ret 8.

CGxDeviceOpenGl::CanDraw.doc: Device vtable +0x3C, called by 0x1365C0 before every frame: true if the viewport (+0xBE4..+0xBF0) has an area. False while minimized. Unlike the Direct3D one (0x140410) it never recovers anything. The gl-context-restore patch hooks it (AFTER). Plain ret.

CGxDeviceOpenGl::ReleaseTextures.doc: glDeleteTextures for every texture of the device (count at +0x540, array at +0x544), clears each texture's GL name (+0x30) and marks it dirty (0x13A1E0), so the upload (vtable +0x00, 0x13EDB0) makes a new one on next use. The game calls it when the window or mode changes (vtable +0x18, +0x20) and when the context is destroyed (0x13AFA0). Plain ret.

CGxDeviceOpenGl::DestroyContext.doc: Ends the GL context: ReleaseTextures, then wglMakeCurrent(0) and wglDeleteContext of the one at +0x580, and releases the window's DC (+0x57C). Called by the mode/window changes (0x13ACB2 and others). Plain ret.

CGxDeviceOpenGl::CreateContext.doc: Makes a GL context for the window at +0x578 (GetDC, wglCreateContext in 0x13F5C0), makes it current, queries the driver (0x13F2E0) and sets up the device's GL state (0x13DCC0). Returns 0 and destroys it on failure. Plain ret.

CGxDeviceOpenGl.texture_count.doc: uint32: how many textures the device has (ReleaseTextures walks them).

CGxDeviceOpenGl.textures.doc: CGxOglTexture**: the device's textures; entries may be 0.

CGxOglTexture.gl_name.doc: GLuint: the texture's GL name, 0 until it's uploaded (ReleaseTextures deletes it and sets 0).

CBLPFile::Open.sig: int(void* this, const char* name, void* context)
CBLPFile::Open.bytes: 55 8b ec 53 56 57 8b d9 e8 a3 f3 ff ff 8b 7d 08
CBLPFile::Open.doc: Loads a whole BLP1 file into the object (+0x4A4 buffer, +0x4A8 size), copies a fixed 0x127-dword header to +8, checks the magic. Returns 1, or 0 for a failed load or a wrong magic. ret 8. The blp-guard patch hooks it (AFTER). See docs/reverse-engineering.md, BLP textures.

CBLPFile.buffer.doc: char*: the whole texture file, as loaded (CBLPFile::Open fills it).

CBLPFile.size.doc: uint32: the texture file's length in bytes.

CBLPFile.header_copy.doc: The fixed-size header copy in CBLPFile::Open (mov ecx,0x127; rep movsd): blp-guard patches it to clamp the copy to the file's length. Bytes b9 27 01 00 00 f3 a5.

CSound::InitMIDI.sig: void(CSound* this, const char* label, int fade_in, int fade_out)
CSound::InitMIDI.doc: Only caller: the CreateMIDISound native (0x1FBE40, at 0x1FBEEA). Since 1.27a ('ambient sound disabled while a MIDI issue is resolved') it makes a plain looping sound from the label (0x238450 with looping 1, which looks it up with 0x356DB0 in the WAV label tables), and MIDISounds.slk labels aren't there, so CSound.sound stays NULL and every map's day/night ambience is silent. The ambient-sound patch hooks it (BEFORE) and makes the MIDI sound instead. ret 0xC.

CreateMIDISnd.sig: void*(const char* label, int open_arg, int fade_in, int fade_out, uint32_t category)
CreateMIDISnd.doc: Makes a MIDI sound object (0x14C bytes, LOOPMIDISNDOBJECT) from a MIDISounds.slk label (lookup 0x341D60 in the table at .data 0xD6A64C), opening its sequence on the Miles MIDI driver; category goes to +0x1C (SoundCategory.*). NULL for an unknown label or without a MIDI driver. open_arg (edx) is passed on as the last argument of the sequence open (0x081B70); the saved-game loader passes 0. The result belongs in CSound.midi. Since 1.27a only the saved-game loader (0x357F87) still calls it; ambient-sound calls it for CreateMIDISound. ret 0xC.

CSound.sound.doc: The sound's WAV object (0x356DB0's result), or NULL. StartSound (0x240640) plays it with 0x359130 if set, else CSound.midi.

CSound.midi.doc: The sound's MIDI object (CreateMIDISnd's result), or NULL. StartSound plays it with 0x359070, the release (0x23B000) frees it with 0x357A00, saved games restore it (0x23C95B).

SoundCategory.ambient.doc: Sound object category bit (+0x1C) for ambient sounds: such a sound plays only while the global sound flags (.data 0xCE5518) have 0x400, the Ambient sounds option.
